name: skillsmith-fx
description: Builds /assets/motion.js (GSAP scroll motion and the hero sessions), /assets/forge.js (the three.js floor) and /assets/stack.js (stacked section cards for hand-written skill pages).

scripts.build: esbuild --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --outdir=../../assets src/forge.js && esbuild --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --outdir=../../assets --external:./forge.js src/motion.js && esbuild --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none src/stack-entry.js --outfile=../../assets/stack.js
